steps.text: The part spins on its cut and stays seated

steps.js: const { gizmo, gzProxy } = app, Q = gzProxy.quaternion.constructor; gizmo.dispatchEvent({ type: 'dragging-changed', value: true }); gzProxy.quaternion.multiply(new Q().setFromAxisAngle(gzProxy.up.clone().set(0, 1, 0), -Math.PI / 12)); gizmo.dispatchEvent({ type: 'objectChange' }); gizmo.dispatchEvent({ type: 'dragging-changed', value: false })
